strace shows NO svc_create/svc_register calls - mountd not attempting RPC registration
recommendations: 1. Fix /etc/netconfig: ensure IPv4 (udp/tcp) entries come BEFORE IPv6 (udp6/tcp6)

5. Verify nfsd kernel threads are running: 'ps aux | grep nfsd'
6. Use 'exportfs -rv' to load exports into kernel BEFORE starting mountd
